Create an AlphaGraph from external representations

Source: R/class_graph.R
alphaGraphConverters.Rd

Construct a canonical graph from a list, JSON, a transition matrix, a graphicalMCP initial graph, or visNetwork node and edge data frames.

Usage

alphaGraphFromList(x, validate = TRUE)

alphaGraphFromJson(json, validate = TRUE)

alphaGraphFromTransitionMatrix(
  transitions,
  hypotheses = NULL,
  type = c("value", "expression", "display"),
  nodeIds = NULL,
  nodeLabels = NULL,
  id = "graph",
  label = id,
  description = NULL,
  metadata = list(),
  settings = list(),
  validate = TRUE
)

alphaGraphFromGraphicalMCP(
  graph,
  id = "graph",
  label = id,
  description = NULL,
  metadata = list(),
  settings = list(),
  validate = TRUE
)

alphaGraphFromVisNetworkData(
  nodes,
  edges,
  id = "graph",
  label = id,
  description = NULL,
  metadata = list(),
  settings = list(),
  validate = TRUE
)

Arguments

x

A JSON-compatible alphagraph list.

validate

Whether to validate the resulting graph.

json

JSON text, a connection, or a file path accepted by jsonlite::fromJSON().

transitions

Square transition matrix or data frame.

hypotheses

Optional hypothesis weights, in matrix order.

type

Interpretation of non-zero transition cells.

nodeIds

Stable node identifiers. Defaults to matrix row names.

nodeLabels

Display labels. Defaults to nodeIds.

id, label, description, metadata, settings

Graph-level properties.

graph

An initial_graph object returned by graphicalMCP::graph_create() or an equivalent list with hypotheses and transitions.

nodes, edges

Data frames accepted by visNetwork::visNetwork().

Value

An AlphaGraph object.
